headline: Bitcoin held near $81,000 after the Fed kept rates on hold with two officials voting for a hike; Coinbase and Strategy report results after the US close on Thursday.

market.asOf: Prices read at about 00:03 UTC Thu 29 Oct (07:03 Thursday Bangkok) from the CoinGecko homepage table: BTC $81,434, ETH $2,368, SOL $102.52. The page did not show the direction of the 24h change, so it is left out. Live prices are at the top of the page.
market.fearGreed: 48 (Neutral) on CoinGecko's Fear & Greed index, read at the same time. The alternative.me index could not be read this run.

stories.title: Bitcoin shrugs off a Fed hold with two votes for a hike
stories.summary: The US Federal Reserve kept its key interest rate range at 3.75-4.00% on Wednesday, in a 10-2 vote where Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack wanted a quarter-point hike. Bitcoin barely moved, and options traders hardly changed their bets on future swings. Traders now see a December hike as likely.
points: The vote was 10-2; Cook and Hammack preferred to raise the range by 1/4 percentage point, per Unchained.
Bitcoin was $81,027 at 4:45pm ET, up 0.33% from just before the 2pm decision, per Unchained.
Deribit's DVOL, a gauge of expected bitcoin swings, was 37.59 at 2pm and 37.58 at 4:45pm ET, per Unchained.
CME FedWatch odds of a December hike: 86% at 2:33pm ET per CoinDesk, and 82.6% (up from 78.3%) in Unchained's 6:03pm ET report.
The next Fed decision is on 9 December, after a two-day meeting on 8-9 December, per the Fed's calendar.

sources.label: Unchained: bitcoin shrugs off a hawkish Fed

stories.title: Coinbase reports on Thursday with a loss expected and a vendor data leak in the background
stories.summary: Coinbase reports third-quarter results after the US close on Thursday 29 October, and analysts expect a loss. Separately, a security incident at Amplitude, an analytics company Coinbase uses, exposed contact details for some customers; Coinbase says its own systems were not breached. Strategy, the largest corporate bitcoin holder, reports the same evening.
points: Analyst forecasts differ: Zacks expects a loss of $0.15 a share on $1.17B revenue; 24/7 Wall St lists a loss of about $0.22 on $1.20B, versus $1.44 a share and $1.87B a year ago.
Coinbase holds a live Q&A at 2:00pm PT (5:00pm ET, 04:00 Friday Bangkok), per the company's notice.

Coinbase says it found no evidence of unauthorized access to its internal systems; security firm SlowMist's estimate of more than 70,000 affected users has not been confirmed by Coinbase, per FinanceFeeds.
Leaked emails and phone numbers are often used for fake 'support' calls and texts: an exchange will never ask for your password, seed phrase or 2FA code.
Strategy reports after the close on 29 October with a webinar at 5:00pm ET, per the company.

sources.label: Zacks via Yahoo Finance: Coinbase Q3 estimates

stories.title: Robinhood's crypto revenue fell 55% from a year ago
stories.summary: Robinhood, a popular trading app, reported third-quarter revenue of $1.42B, but its crypto revenue fell 55% from a year earlier to $120M. Its new prediction-market business brought in more than its crypto trading did. The shares fell after the report, though some Wall Street analysts kept positive ratings.
points: Total Q3 revenue was $1.42B, per The Block.
Crypto revenue fell 55% from a year earlier to $120M, per The Block.
Prediction markets brought in $173M, per The Block.
StoneX kept a $170 price target and Bernstein a $160 target, per The Block.

briefs.title: Bitcoin ETFs in, ether ETFs out
briefs.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs took in about $176M on Tue 27 Oct, led by BlackRock's IBIT at $151.5M, while spot ether ETFs lost about $60M, per Bitcoin.com News. Wednesday's flow figures were not out at the time of writing.

briefs.title: Big Tech after hours: Alphabet down, Microsoft up
briefs.summary: Alphabet shares fell about 7% after hours on an earnings miss while Microsoft rose, per CoinDesk, setting the tone for stocks into Thursday.

briefs.title: Google Cloud previews crypto custody
briefs.summary: Google Cloud is testing a custody service for institutions to hold digital assets, with a commercial launch planned for early 2027, per Finance Magnates.

briefs.title: CFTC reportedly looks again at Polymarket
briefs.summary: Citing Reuters, Bitcoin Magazine reports the CFTC is checking whether Polymarket broke its 2022 settlement by letting US users reach its offshore exchange. A probe is an inquiry, not a finding.

briefs.title: Coinbase adds Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin
briefs.summary: Coinbase listed Ripple's dollar stablecoin RLUSD across its retail app, Exchange and Prime, per The Block.

briefs.title: Strategy shareholders back daily dividends
briefs.summary: Preliminary results show about 99.3% of votes in favour of letting Strategy's preferred shares pay dividends daily, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Midterms could change crypto policy
briefs.summary: Kalshi bettors give Democrats about a 64% chance of winning the Senate in next week's midterm elections, and the stalled Clarity Act market-structure bill may lose priority, per The Block.
